qs.s: La patineuse exécute un ___ parfait sur la glace.
qs.en: The skater performs a perfect slide on the ice.

qs.s: Le ___ des plaques tectoniques provoque des tremblements de terre.
qs.en: The sliding of tectonic plates causes earthquakes.

qs.s: Le ___ du rocher a bloqué la route de montagne.
qs.en: The slipping of the rock blocked the mountain road.

qs.s: Un ___ de terrain a emporté plusieurs maisons après les fortes pluies.
qs.en: A landslide carried away several houses after the heavy rain.

qs.en: This word has undergone a drift in meaning over the centuries.

qs.en: The semantic drift of this term makes it difficult to translate.

qs.en: A gradual drift toward authoritarianism is observed in this region.

qs.s: Le ___ de la situation politique inquiète les observateurs internationaux.
qs.en: The drift of the political situation worries international observers.

qs.en: There was a significant slip on that slope.

qs.en: The company hired an external auditor to check its accounts.

qs.s: L'___ du cabinet a relevé plusieurs irrégularités dans le bilan financier.
qs.en: The auditor from the firm identified several irregularities in the financial report.

qs.en: This radio programme attracts thousands of listeners every evening.

qs.en: As a loyal listener of that station, he never misses a programme.

qs.en: This village has managed to preserve its native craftsmanship in the face of globalization.

qs.en: This indigenous community has been claiming its ancestral lands for generations.

qs.en: The indigenous way of life was profoundly disrupted by European colonization.

qs.en: These indigenous craftsmen make objects using techniques passed down from generation to generation.

qs.en: The native language of this region is now taught in local schools.

qs.en: A rare native plant was discovered in this protected forest.

qs.en: The indigenous populations of this archipelago have lived by fishing for centuries.

qs.s: Ces tribus ___ ont conservé leurs traditions malgré la modernisation rapide.
qs.en: These indigenous tribes have preserved their traditions despite rapid modernization.
